intro: Check each new inquiry’s CRM and notification steps. Open a lead to review its recorded outcomes.
accepted_note: Provider accepted means the provider acknowledged the request. It does not prove that an email arrived in an inbox or that someone contacted the lead.
load_error: Delivery status could not be loaded. Refresh to try again. No missing values have been replaced with zero.
waiting_for_contact: Waiting for a confirmed CRM contact before this step can run.
legacy_note: Only inquiries accepted after delivery tracking was enabled have these records. Earlier leads are not queued or resent.
summary_scope: These totals cover all tracked inquiries, regardless of the table filters. Step totals count requests, not unique leads. Refresh for the latest status.

worker.title: Notification worker
worker.paused_help: The durable delivery worker is disabled. New website inquiries use the existing immediate notification path; existing queued steps will not run until the worker is enabled.
worker.error_help: The latest worker check recorded an internal error. Ask an administrator to review service configuration and the worker before expecting queued steps to run.
worker.awaiting_help: Delivery tracking is enabled, but no worker check has been recorded yet. Refresh after the service starts.
worker.stale_help: No recent worker check was recorded when this report was generated. Queued steps may be delayed; inspect the service before requeuing work.
worker.polling_help: A recent worker check was recorded. Each step below still has its own outcome; a worker check alone does not prove delivery.

queue.title: Delivery steps
queue.invalid_id: Enter a complete inquiry UUID, or leave this filter blank.
queue.caption: Recorded delivery steps for the selected filters
queue.empty: No delivery steps match these filters.

errors.configuration: Required delivery configuration is missing. Correct the configuration before a safe retry.
errors.destination_changed: The configured destination changed. Review the original request; it will not be redirected automatically.
errors.payload_review: The stored request needs review. It will not be sent with changed content.
errors.expired_window: The provider’s safe duplicate-protection window expired. Review the provider before taking further action.
errors.not_connected: A connection was not established. A bounded retry can run when scheduled.
errors.disabled: This integration was disabled when the step was checked.
errors.no_note: There was no note content for this step.
errors.uncertain: The provider may have accepted this request. It must be reviewed to avoid a duplicate.
errors.review: This step needs an administrator’s review. Customer information and provider responses are not shown here.

confirm.title: Queue this known failed step?
confirm.body: Queue {{step}} only. The server rechecks that this recorded failure is safe to retry and has attempts remaining. This action queues work; it does not contact the provider immediately. Accepted or uncertain steps are not replayed.

notices.queued: The safe retry was queued. Refresh to follow the worker’s recorded outcome.
notices.not_retryable: This step changed or is no longer safe to retry. The status has been refreshed; no retry was queued by this request.
notices.retry_unconfirmed: The requeue response could not be confirmed. Review the refreshed status before trying again; the server prevents a second requeue of an already queued step.

detail.title: Inquiry delivery details
detail.error: This inquiry’s delivery details could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
detail.review_note: No automatic resend is allowed for an uncertain outcome. Check the provider’s records before deciding what to do next.
